verdict.rationale: Summer Engine exposes agent-facing surfaces (an MCP server and a CLI), so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair axis for this product. The evidence pack contains no documented API versions, version pinning, or deprecation policy. The `--channel next` pre-release option is a release-channel switch, which is an adjacent feature and does not count as versioned APIs, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
